sources.title: Building and deploying AI agents with E2B - DEV Community
sources.snippet: What is E2B? E2B is a platform used to augment building AI autonomous agents. It allows you to provide your AI agent access to tools in a safe, sandboxed environment. With its sandbox feature, you can set up an environment with whatever tools and packages your AI agent requires for the tasks you want it to accomplish.
